definitions.explanation: The act of evaluating or determining the value, quality, or status of something, especially in business or financial contexts.

examples.japanese: {中古車|ちゅうこしゃ}の{査定|さてい}を{依頼|いらい}した。
examples.english: I requested an appraisal of the used car.

examples.japanese: {人事|じんじ}{査定|さてい}は{年|ねん}に{二回|にかい}{行|おこな}われる。
examples.english: Performance evaluations are conducted twice a year.

examples.japanese: {損害|そんがい}{額|がく}を{査定|さてい}する。

notes:
WORD STRUCTURE:
{査|さ} (investigate) + {定|てい} (determine)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{査定|さてい}を{受|う}ける - to be evaluated
・{査定|さてい}を{行|おこな}う - to conduct an assessment
・{査定|さてい}{額|がく} - assessed value
・{査定|さてい}{結果|けっか} - assessment results

TYPES OF {査定|さてい}:
・{人事|じんじ}{査定|さてい} - personnel evaluation
・{給与|きゅうよ}{査定|さてい} - salary assessment
・{保険|ほけん}{査定|さてい} - insurance assessment
・{不動産|ふどうさん}{査定|さてい} - real estate appraisal
・{車|くるま}の{査定|さてい} - car appraisal

REGISTER:
Formal. Standard business and legal terminology.
